label: D1 in the last ~10 trials of the episode after an a1 choice
explanation: Fires only at D1 (0 activations at GO/D2) and only near the end of the episode: 99% of activation mass is at ep_trial 90-99 and none before trial 80. Every activation falls in the lowest value-head bin (value < 5.22), which matches the drop in value as the episode ends. It strongly prefers trials after an a1 choice (87% of mass with prev_action == 1, under 1% with prev_action == 2; most of the rest is window-start trials where prev_action is unknown) and choice logits that are mildly positive (toward a1). Previous reward input raises the rate (in_rew=1 gives 3x lift), but restricting to rewarded trials loses recall. It is not driven by transition type, core pattern or stay/switch. The phase+late-episode predicate alone gets recall 0.98 at precision 0.10. Adding prev_action==1 and ep_trial>=93 gives dev F1 0.45, mass recall 0.82. Firing within the predicate is sporadic (precision about 0.3), so the description is incomplete. Uses only observed variables (episode time and the agent own past choice).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D1 & value_bin=decile 0 (9 = highest) (+4.80), phase=D1 & ep_dec=9 (+3.10), phase=D1 & before=a1 S2 u (+2.98), value_bin=decile 0 (9 = highest) (+2.82), phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 8 (9 = most a1) (+2.38), phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 7 (9 = most a1) (+1.56).
